conventions.testing: Unit tests in #[cfg(test)] modules, integration tests via SemanticExtractor
conventions.linting: Clippy lints defined in Cargo.toml, deny unused/unwrap/expect
conventions.error_handling: Option/Result patterns, thiserror for custom errors

patterns: Language registration via get_language_info() match in mod.rs
Query constants (ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY) as pub const in language module
Extension mapping via EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs

related_issues.title: add Swift grammar support via tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3

constraints: Must follow existing language registration pattern (model after java.rs)
Must add DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable/assignment tracking
Must add tree-sitter-swift to workspace dependencies
test_coverage: Language registration has unit tests in mod.rs tests module (test_get_language_info_known, test_get_language_info_unknown, test_get_ts_language_known, test_get_ts_language_unknown). Java has integration tests for element_query and extract_inheritance.

library_findings.notes: Core parsing library used by all language handlers

approaches.name: Direct Java Model
approaches.description: Create swift.rs following java.rs pattern exactly: ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_inheritance handler, and register in mod.rs

approaches.name: Minimal Registration
approaches.description: Add only language registration without handlers, defer query implementation

approaches.name: Enhanced with Protocol Support
approaches.description: Extend pattern to include protocol_declaration in ELEMENT_QUERY and protocol inheritance in extract_inheritance

recommendation: Direct Java Model - follows proven pattern, balances completeness with maintainability, and matches issue requirements.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(function_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @function_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @class_name) @class
(struct_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @struct_name) @class
(protocol_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @protocol_name) @class
(enumeration_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @enum_name) @class
(extension_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @extension_name) @class
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-swift grammar (alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift v0.7.3): class_declaration has 'inheritance_clause' child containing 'type_inheritance_clause' with 'type' children; each type has 'type_identifier' for superclass and 'protocol_composition_type' for protocols. Extract via node.child_by_field_name("inheritance_clause") then iterate type children.
